::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customer_segments/attributes"}
#docs
Served rather than mirrored in a client, so a filter builder cannot offer a control the engine would reject.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.field` | `string` | The customer field name to filter on. |
| `data.label` | `string` | The label shown for the field. |
| `data.group` | `string` | The group the field is listed under. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | The field's type, which sets the operators it accepts. One of `text`, `enum`, `bool`, `number`, `date`. |
| `data.ops` | `array of string` | The operators this field accepts. |
| `data.options` | `array of object` | Closed vocabulary for an enum, so the builder offers values. |
| `data.hint` | `string` | Help text for the field. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
